items.title: Building brand memory beyond the campaign - Adgully.com
items.raw_summary: Marketing has become exceptionally good at creating moments. A campaign launches, media goes live, creators amplify it, engagement peaks, results are reported, and almost immediately the conversation moves to the next brief. There is nothing inherently wrong with this system. Campaigns are useful: they create attention, introduce ideas and give brands timely reasons to enter conversations. But I often find myself coming back to a different question — what remains after the campaign ends?
items.title_pt: Building brand memory beyond the campaign
items.summary_pt: Campanhas criam momentos, mas o desafio é construir memória de marca que perdura além do fim delas.
items.pme_pt: Reforça que posicionamento profundo (essência) é o que deixa marca memorável — não apenas execução tática; é o começo que o Livro estrutura.

items.title: Innovation and branding take center stage at 2026 publishing conference - China Daily Global Edition
items.raw_summary: The 2026 Publishing Imprint Influence Conference concluded successfully in Guangzhou, Guangdong province, on Thursday. Co-hosted this year by Southern Publishing and Media Co, Ltd and Bookdao, a publishing and book market intelligence information platform, the conference marked its third consecutive edition and was held for the first time as part of the Southern China Book Fair. Bringing together institution representatives, brand managers, and industry experts from the publishing sector across the country, the event convened in Guangzhou to explore the pathways and possibilities for building a publishing brand through data insights, strategic dialogue, and brand recognition.
